info.title: BeliefState Intelligence API
info.description: Four research resources: Brief for ticker research, Beliefs for records and evidence, Sources for the research directory, and Tickers for coverage. REST research uses API keys; AI clients use OAuth through /mcp. Accountless x402 research offers 20 paid tools through HTTP and native MCP. On this server, /v1/research is the free catalog with exact per-tool prices and schemas; /v1/research/mcp is wallet MCP. Data calls cost 0.02 USDC on Base; model comparison 0.50; model-assisted search 1.50. Read the exact quote before paying.

get.summary: Review a stock thesis today and its conditional future case
get.description: Use detail=current for a bounded stored view of up to three current reviewed Beliefs with attached Risks, Catalysts, evidence URLs and clocks, under a 32KiB logical ceiling. Unknown lifecycle/severity/history remain explicit; complete cases and history use separate reads. Otherwise returns a current-and-future research_outlook by default for released stocks: original thesis, later developments, current assessment, future mechanism, necessary conditions and invalidation, with dated sources and explicit coverage gaps. Missing or stale requested inputs refresh automatically; historical reads replay only then-recorded assessments. Also returns approved public investor thesis summaries for one ticker, including attributed people, claims, revisions, fixed horizon outcomes, a dated market_price with its provider source and freshness, the latest since inception underlying market mark, and provenance labeled BeliefState thesis packets covering changes, reasons, disagreements, catalysts, risks, invalidations, comparable history, unknowns, and citations. Each active thesis includes price_opportunity with explicit author targets, separate horizons, dated prices, remaining conditional price change, and whether the current price is near or beyond the target. Target distances are not expected returns or proof of current thesis validity. Optional sector_context adds separately attributed research from companies with observed SEC industry relationships. It may be the only research available for a discovered listing; do not transfer peer directions, targets, or conviction to the requested company. Missing optional fields remain unknown. Briefs and detail may include dated engine context assessments separating source assertions, independent checking inputs and conditional stock-price mechanisms. Open context_assessment_id through get_cases for exact permitted Evidence and visuals. context_assessed ordered changes use that identity without fabricating an author Belief. Preserve original publication, revision, assessment and customer availability times. current_market_mark is an unadjusted snapshot, separate from the adjusted daily-close market_price; use its feed scope, basis, session and clocks. Cached/historical reads do not acquire new marks; refresh_market_data=true refreshes missing or stale marks for current requests only. Unavailable or stale marks do not imply live prices.

metadata.title: Ticker research brief
metadata.description: Query attributed investor theses, supporting evidence, risks, changes, and available outcomes for one ticker through the BeliefState research API.

x-x402.description: No account or API key. One overview read costs 0.02 USDC on Base. BeliefState pays any Maryland sales tax separately; the buyer total stays 0.02. Retry the identical URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE after the 402 quote. Retain PAYMENT-RESPONSE and BELIEFSTATE-PAYMENT-RECEIPT. Recovery requires the original private mppx nonce salt or a fresh paying-wallet signature; a public settlement signature alone cannot recover data. On 401, sign BELIEFSTATE-REPLAY-CHALLENGE and retry the same purchase with BELIEFSTATE-REPLAY-PROOF. Bearer access keeps its existing contract.

Maximum returned views. Overview returns at most five (default five); larger valid requests are capped at five with explicit returned and omitted counts. Full supports 1–20. Omit for an ordinary overview.

Issuer_evidence lists retained SEC filing captures. To inspect a document, reuse its as_of with issuer_document_id and a literal issuer_query; continue with issuer_match_offset. This is a stored, metered evidence read without collection or model calls. Current returns up to three reviewed current Beliefs with up to three Risks and three Catalysts each, direct evidence URLs, clocks and explicit unknowns under 32KiB. Attached open Risks or materialized Risks with supported continuing relevance qualify, without age/severity exclusion; unknown concerns remain separately qualified. Selection reserves opposing views, then distinct stances, effective/publication recency, observed recency and stable ID. Omitted whole cases have continuations/detail references. Current is a stored read and cannot refresh. Start with overview for research questions: it includes complete selected cases, dated developments, assessment and citations. Full is for a complete machine export; oversized full company reads through MCP return an explicitly bounded overview with case IDs for get_case drill-down. REST detail=full retains the export. Fund briefs return fund_overview for either value.
Four-character exchange MIC, such as XLON, XTSE, XTKS or XHKG. Use with ticker.
Released entity ID returned by get_subjects or GET /v1/beliefs?view=entities. Use exactly one of ticker or entity_id.
For detail=issuer_evidence, select a document_id returned by its inventory; also pass the returned as_of and a literal issuer_query.
Literal phrase to find across one complete retained SEC document. Returns up to five cited excerpts, including beyond cached text prefixes; no raw document export.
Continue with next_match_offset and unchanged ticker, as_of, issuer_document_id and issuer_query. Each read uses normal research allowance or credit.
Return a free current ticker overview when a company snapshot is available. Requires a customer API key and uses no research credits.

get.summary: Find investor beliefs or inspect a full record
get.description: Returns compact, filterable, point in time summaries of released investor beliefs. Use view=risks or view=catalysts with exactly one ticker/entity/Belief/released-corpus scope for typed objects and supported status, severity, Source, author and publication filters. Use view=track_record with person_id and one explicit scope for existing publication-based outcome cohorts; losses, pending observations and unknown history remain visible. These map to get_risks, get_catalysts and get_investor_outcomes in MCP. Object cursors bind all filters and the cutoff. Use view=search with q (1–2000 characters) to search released investment cases, theses, mechanisms, catalysts and risks across the library without a ticker or entity. Hybrid text and semantic retrieval with passage relevance filtering returns ranked belief IDs, exact derived passages and citations; read belief_id for complete context. Optional ticker or entity_id narrows scope; person_id, direction, status, time_horizon, changed_since and as_of are explicit filters. Trade/setup wording belongs in q: trade_type and other unsupported fields are rejected, not silently applied. Search defaults to 10 results (maximum 50), one supporting passage per belief, 128 KiB total MCP payload and a top-40 candidate window. Follow next_cursor within 15 minutes; it freezes query, cutoff, generation and order while access is rechecked. coverage.status=partial means incomplete indexing and no charge; ranking.status=partial means refused candidates were withheld and no charge; an unavailable index/provider returns data_unavailable. Relevance does not establish author agreement or verified trades. Customer AI keeps private preferences and assembles the answer. Inspect investment_case.relationship_coverage before using links. Preserve citation_ids, endpoint identity_citation_ids, available_at, period and uncertainty. source_explicit is stated; source_implied follows the source argument; engine_inferred is BeliefState reasoning, never the author's view. Unknown collection differs from an empty collected array. Optional relationship_paths on belief_id returns bounded paths within the originating case: use released from_entity_id, optional to_entity_id, max_depth up to 3 and edge_budget up to 100. Resolve returned edge indexes against the direct relationships. No causal magnitude or portfolio weight is implied. Briefs and detail may include dated engine context assessments separating source assertions, independent checking inputs and conditional stock-price mechanisms. Open context_assessment_id through get_cases for exact permitted Evidence and visuals. context_assessed ordered changes use that identity without fabricating an author Belief. Preserve original publication, revision, assessment and customer availability times. current_market_mark is an unadjusted snapshot, separate from the adjusted daily-close market_price; use its feed scope, basis, session and clocks. Cached/historical reads do not acquire new marks; refresh_market_data=true refreshes missing or stale marks for current requests only. Unavailable or stale marks do not imply live prices. Use view=compare with distinct belief_id and compare_to_belief_id for a cited engine comparison (supports, contradicts, directed depends_on, unknown or unrelated). Optional comparison_focus (1–500 characters) scopes a public research topic while retaining both complete cases. The returned relation covers that focus only; no matching proposition means unknown. Focused and whole-case receipts are separate. Source overlap reports shared Evidence, URLs, revisions and content hashes; absence of overlap never proves independence. Complete cases are limited to eight paragraphs each and 20,000 characters combined. One read is metered; unavailable comparisons are uncharged. Historical as_of reads only replay assessments recorded by the cutoff and never create or backdate them. Shared topics or opposite trades do not establish a relation. Use belief_id for decision_review (current evidence comparison or an explicit review gap) and the complete record with its documented investor twin: source linked memories, stated conditions, separate author and condition timestamps, and a versioned snapshot hash. Optional scenario contains up to eight condition status assumptions; JSON encode it in the REST query. Scenarios do not change evidence or predict the investor's response. Use view=entities with optional q and kind to discover released subjects and security listings, then entity_id for their cited belief inventory. Non-stock belief_id reads expose author conditions and explicit market capability gaps; scenario and investor twins remain listing-only. Use changed_since to find changed beliefs and person_id with ticker or entity_id to inspect an investor’s recorded history. A cursor freezes collection query state and as_of. When the ordered change feed is released, use view=changes with exactly one ticker, entity_id, belief_id or corpus=released selector. Drain continuation_cursor before saving polling_checkpoint; next poll uses checkpoint. For subject_resolution_changed and same-case case_selection_changed hold/restoration, compare before/after relationships as dated engine projections, preserving coverage and citations. A held notice can retain the permitted dated graph of that same formerly promoted case; current held case content remains withheld. Selection changes during a paged window require authorized resynchronization. Restoring a held checkpoint also requires resynchronization because its baseline or later changes may have been withheld. Source or admission withdrawal still requires authorized resynchronization. Different-candidate selection archives remain unknown. When a graph is omitted, use its methodology.relationship_detail_queries entry with get_cases; null references or graph states remain unknown. Snapshot cutoffs bracket the assessment at millisecond precision; competing mappings or interpretation choices inside that bracket remain unknown. If status=resync_required, repeat the explicit selector with resync=true, drain its authorized inventory, then save its checkpoint. Keep author publication, engine assessment and customer availability distinct. No portfolio upload or broker action is required. Disabled or uninitialized history cannot issue a checkpoint.
